candidate_reports.remark: Peak wind gust at Hydaburg Seaplane base.
Peak gust at Ketchikan Airport.

511 report Klondike Highway: mile 12 to White Pass: around 9 to 10 inches since 8 am Saturday with light snow falling. Mile 8 to 12: 6 to 7 inches of snow with light snow falling. Mile 3 to 8: 3 to 4 inches of snow with a rain/snow mix falling.
Peak gust at Craig.
Peak gust at Hydaburg Seaplane Base. Occurred twice_ once at 1239 pm and again at 123 pm.
Peak gust at Klawock Airport.
Cape Decision Light report via the Alaska Marine Exchange.
Ward Cove Mesonet reported a 69 mph wind gust at 10:02 AM AKST.
Chester Lake Dam CWOP reported a 95 mph wind gust at 11:35 AM AKST.
SPXA2 reported a 69 mph wind gust at 11:52 AM AKST.
MWSA2 reported a 66 mph gust at 12:00 PM AKST.
MWSA2 reported a 66 mph gust at 12:00 PM AKST.
GW5794 reported a 66 mph wind gust at 12:10 PM AKST.
Peak wind gust at Hydaburg Seaplane Base.
PAHY reported a 64 mph wind gust at 12:56 PM AKST.
City Fire Chief reported a tree across Fair Street near City Park due to high winds within the last hour.
City Fire Chief reported multiple trees down across the northern Ketchikan area due high winds within the last hour. Trees in the power lines in this area have caused a power outage.
Report of a broken street light on raven street near intersection with airport road.

Reported heavy rain and strong winds. Barometric pressure is 29.05 and falling. Winds out of the S to SE at 35 mph with a high gust of 68 mph around 1pm. 1.46 in of rain since 6am. Still have power but flickering. Multiple trees across the rd south of town on Loggers Ln and 1 small debris flow. Spotty water over the road due to volume in the culverts.
report of power line down at the intersection of 8th Ave and Tait Street.
Tree fell across road and impacted power lines causing a power outage. Power was fully restored by 630pm local time Friday Nov 6th.
Peak wind of 57 knots (66 mph) measured at 821 AM AKST. An additional peak wind of 54 knots (62 mph) measured at 917 AM AKST.
Trained spotter report of a downed tree at the foot of the O'Connell Bridge.
Peak wind of 50 knots (58 mph) measured at PAYA.
AIPCo Metlakatla CWOP measured a peak wind of 64 mph.
